thread:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — we just got a request to add Varuna-7B (LLM from OpenSourceX) to the catalog. Need a fast triage: licensing, perf baseline, memory/kv cache compatibility, and rollout plan. Who can own which bits?
Alex Chen: I can do perf baseline + quantization matrix. Aim to get a perf CSV by EOD tomorrow. Any target metrics?
Priya Nair: Target: < 120ms token latency p50 on 8k ctx with 1-token batching for hosted; embedding quality should match our silica-7b baseline within 5% on rouge/eval set.
Miguel Torres: I'll run it through the model adapter and check runtime kernel coverage. Heads-up: varuna uses some fused attention variant — may need kernel mapping.
Zoe Park: Legal flag — license is "Modified-BSD-SSP" with an attribution clause plus an unusual redistribution clause. @legal please confirm but this might block Dedicated/Private distribution until we get a CLA-like exception.
Elena Gomez: Curation note: need sample inference outputs (100 prompts) so we can run safety/evals. I'll queue the eval set; can someone drop the model SFT/sample tar?
Casey Li: On infra: does it require >16GB kv-per-shard? If so, Dedicated autoscale config might need a different shape. Raj, can you check GPU memory footprint after conversion?
Rajiv Patel: I'll spin a quick conversion to fp16 + static int8 profile on staging and report memory. ETA ~3h.
Priya Nair: Ownership suggestion: Alex = perf + quant, Miguel = runtime/kernel/adaptor, Rajiv = infra/memory + canary infra, Zoe = licensing + legal liaison, Elena = evals + safety, Priya = release coordinator. OK?
Alex Chen: Ack. I'll start with default hf conversion:
```
python -m hf_convert --model varuna-7b --out varuna7b-fp16 --ops=int8_static
```
And then run our perf harness across 1/2/4/8 sequence lengths.
Miguel Torres: If the fused attention operator isn't in our kernel table, I can stub a fallback to slower matmul path for canary — but perf will suffer. That said, we should still register the model as "alpha" in the catalog with a fallback policy.
Zoe Park: Legal: I've left a note on the ticket. This redistribution clause requires an approval; recommend we mark as "hosted-only" until legal signs off. Can we still run perf and evals in hosted?
Priya Nair: Yes, we can run hosted-only experiments. We just need to flag the catalog entry. Elena, please proceed with evals in hosted sandbox.
Elena Gomez: Will do. Dropping tasks: upload prompts + toxicity set, run 1000 queries, compare to silica-7b baseline. ETA: 48h.
catalog-bot: model-ingest: started new intake id VAR-2026-03-17-01 by Priya Nair. status=queued
Casey Li: Small note on rollout policy: prefer canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% with automatic rollback if latency regresses >10% or error rate >1%. Also, add a live metric for kv-cache-evictions.
Priya Nair: Good point. Add rollout config like this in the model manifest:
```
rollout:
  strategy: gradual
  steps: [1,5,25,100]
  monitors:
    - name: token_latency_p50
      threshold_pct: 10
    - name: error_rate
      threshold_pct: 1
  fallback: silica-7b
```
Rajiv Patel: Confirmed memory footprint after fp16+int8 stub: peak per-shard ~13.7GB with kv cache; fits 16GB A100 but leaves little headroom. Need to avoid aggressive batch sizes on some tiers.
Alex Chen: Perf quick results (local harness): p50 token latency 142ms on 8k ctx with fallback matmul — above target. With fused-attention optimized kernels (Miguel's path) simulated, estimates drop to ~95ms. So optimization is required for hosted SLO.
Miguel Torres: I'll prioritize the kernel mapping; if we can ship a patched kernel in the runtime within 5 business days we should hit SLO. Otherwise plan B = quant+smaller sequence length advisory for hosted.
Zoe Park: Legal asks: keep user-facing docs clear about "hosted-only" status until redistribution is cleared. Also track any third-party weights that might impose use constraints.
Elena Gomez: Eval plan: run toxicity, instruction-following, and embedding-sim tests. If embedding drift >5% vs silica baseline, we'll mark vector-search as not-recommended.
Priya Nair: Action items recap: 
- Alex: perf matrix + final numbers (EOD tomorrow)
- Miguel: kernel mapping feasibility and ETA (2 days?)
- Rajiv: memory and canary infra config (3h + canary template)
- Zoe: legal review status (ping legal)
- Elena: evals (48h)
- Casey: rollout manifest + monitors (today)
I'll assemble a short catalog draft entry after we have perf + legal notes.
Alex Chen: Quick ping — I'm going to open a CR for the conversion script and perf harness changes. Please review: PR #3021 when ready.
Miguel Torres: I'll review the CR and add a note about kernel fallback.
Zoe Park: @legal — any update?
Priya Nair: Also: small dependency: if kernel change requires runtime bump, we need to coordinate an infra deploy with eng-runtime. Miguel, can you write the compatibility matrix so eng-runtime can triage?
Miguel Torres: Yup, will add matrix to the PR.
Rajiv Patel: Canary template ready: will attach to the intake ticket.
catalog-bot: model-ingest: VAR-2026-03-17-01 status=processing by Alex Chen
Elena Gomez: Started eval run on hosted sandbox (run id eval-246810). Will post results when done.
Casey Li: Ping on CR review — I can help with infra test harness once Alex's PR is up.
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. If any blocker pops up (legal redistribution denial, kernel infeasible), call it out here and we'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
